name: Free Music Archive (FMA) Dataset
description: A dataset of music audio tracks from the Free Music Archive, with metadata and genre labels, intended for music information retrieval research. The FMA-small and FMA-medium subsets contain 30-second audio excerpts.
citation: Defferrard, M., Benzi, K., Vandergheynst, P., and Bresson, X. (2017). FMA: A Dataset For Music Analysis. Proceedings of the 18th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR 2017), 316–323. https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.01840
